text:
matt_prod: Quick async Q3 OKR milestone check-in — 60s please: what shipped, what slipped, owners & next steps. @aisha_eng @raj_eng @claire_pm

aisha_eng: Shipped: runtime v3 autoscale tuning rolled to canary. PR #4123 merged, p50 latency ~12% down on standard traces :tada:

raj_eng: Slipped: kv-cache eviction rework. Hit memory fragmentation under multi-tenant sim load. ETA: EOD Fri for a proper fix. Filed short RFC in docs (see thread).

claire_pm: Noted. Product impact: this pushes Dedicated-capacity perf milestone by ~1 sprint unless we have an interim mitigation. Any quick wins?

matt_prod: @raj any short-term mitigation to avoid the slip becoming customer-impacting?

raj_eng: Short term plan: disable aggressive prefetch and tighten per-tenant evict thresholds. Cuts peak throughput slightly but avoids OOMs. I'll open a rollback/mitigation PR by tomorrow morning.

leo_devops: I can stage a canary config with the relaxed prefetch today, run through perf harness.

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff: runtime-v3-tune -> cluster:canary-c3 (started by leo_devops)

devex-bot: Reminder: add merged PRs to release-notes.md and tag with `q3-okrs` for the weekly digest.

claire_pm: Owners & next steps (one-liners):
- Shipped: runtime perf tuning — owner: aisha_eng (docs + release note)
- Slipped: kv-cache eviction rework — owner: raj_eng (mitigation + full fix)
- Blocker: payments rate-limit dependency — pinging payments team (ben_payments)

ben_payments: Confirmed. We'll bump the soft quota for dedicated test tenants tomorrow AM, no code changes required on our side.

matt_prod: Action items: 1) raj_eng — mitigation PR by Thu AM, full fix EOD Fri; 2) leo_devops — run canary + post perf numbers in this thread; 3) aisha_eng — update release notes & short bullet doc for console; 4) claire_pm — update roadmap and draft customer comms. I'll consolidate status on Monday. :+1:

raj_eng: ack, starting on mitigation PR tonight.

leo_devops: ack, canary running now, will paste perf samples in ~2h.

aisha_eng: Adding release note and changelog entry now.

claire_pm: Drafting customer-facing note, will share in #customer-success for review.

matt_prod: Thanks all. Quick ask — for any blocked CRs, ping `#code-review` and add label `q3-okrs` so I can triage reviews faster.

raj_eng: will do :thumbsup:

leo_devops: perf samp (canary -> baseline): p50 120ms -> 105ms, p95 unchanged. More runs ongoing.

matt_prod: Good progress. If anything slips further, call it out here and we'll re-prioritize.
